missing_components.description: A workflow to handle payment confirmation is missing, ensuring payment is completed before a rental is finalized.
Business logic for handling overdue rentals or automatic renewals is not specified.
UI module for managing 'Items' is missing, meaning there is no interface to view or manage inventory directly.

risks.impact: May lead to rentals being processed without successfully confirming payment.

risks.description: No defined process for overdue rentals.
risks.impact: Could result in improper inventory and customer handling, affecting revenue collection.

recommendations.action: Implement a workflow for confirming payments post-customer acceptance of rental terms to ensure financial transactions are completed.
Develop business logic for managing overdue rentals and handling automatic renewals or notifications.
Add a UI module for 'Items' to allow staff to manage and view inventory items directly within the application.
